result.reason: The clause adds the frequency cap, 30-day written notice, business-hours limitation, independent auditor, and confidentiality requirement, but it does not expressly prohibit direct access to Licensee systems. The cost shift also applies to any “discrepancy,” rather than specifically an underpayment exceeding 5%. In addition, requiring the audit both “within 30 days” after the request and on at least 30 days’ prior notice creates an unnecessary timing tension. The non-interference language and relocation of the cost paragraph go beyond the changes strictly required, although the underlying audit purpose and mutual auditor-selection mechanism are preserved.
